dict.string: Isleta asks your music app what’s playing so it can show the current track in the island when Isleta starts. Live updates need no permission.
Isleta shows your AirPods and other Bluetooth audio devices in the island when they connect, with the charge left in them. Nothing about your devices leaves your Mac.
Isleta reads your upcoming events so it can show what’s next in the island. Your events are never stored, never sent anywhere, and never written to Isleta’s logs.
Isleta checks whether a Focus is on so it can stay quiet when you have asked your Mac for quiet. It never changes your Focus, and it never records it.

Isleta uses your location to show the weather where you are. You can type a city instead — and either way, your location is only ever sent to Apple’s weather service.
